title: All for the Love of Meloetta!
overview: An unexpected encounter with an old friend in Virbank City presents our heroes with unexpected challenges galore!

title: Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!
overview: With Cynthia's help, our heroes have begun training for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, and a couple of old friends come along for the wild ride!

title: Expedition to Onix Island!
overview: When our heroes take a break from special training, a mysterious island offers much more than they bargained for!

title: The Mystery of the Missing Cubchoo!
overview: As our heroes train for the upcoming Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a worried neighbor of Cynthia's comes by for help!

title: Iris and the Rogue Dragonite!
overview: While our heroes continue preparations for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a sudden emergency and a Pokémon in need change their lives forever!

title: Jostling for the Junior Cup! (1)
overview: The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off to a roaring start, while our heroes are faced with rivals old and new!

title: Battling Authority Once Again! (2)
overview: The second round of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off and running, while a battle between the winner and Alder waits in the wings!

title: Ash, Iris, and Trip: Then There Were Three! (3)
overview: The exciting Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup continues, and the semi-finals and finals hang in the balance of the results of these last two matches!

title: Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure! (4)
overview: The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup may be winding down, but new adventures are just beginning!

title: The Road to Humilau!
overview: Our heroes' new friend Cameron needs to win his eighth Gym badge in order to enter the Unova League, and that sets the stage for an unforgettable adventure!

title: Unrest at the Nursery!
overview: While Ash trains for entry into the Unova League, our heroes discover a Pokémon nursery that urgently needs their help!

title: Meloetta and the Undersea Temple!
overview: A sinister plot to take over the Unova region is taking shape, and our heroes are caught in the middle of it!

title: Unova's Survival Crisis!
overview: Team Rocket's "Operation Tempest" is under way with a fierce vengeance, and the fate of the Unova region hangs in the balance!

title: Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!
overview: On their way to the site of the upcoming Unova League, our heroes take on an unexpectedly messy battle challenge!

title: A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!
overview: As our heroes continue their trek to Vertress City and the Unova League, they're challenged to a Tag Battle the likes of which they've never experienced!

title: A Village Homecoming!
overview: Our heroes are visiting the Village of Dragons on their way to Vertress City, where Iris is confronted with several life-changing challenges!

title: Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!
overview: As Iris takes on her battle challenge issued by the Opelucid City Gym Leader Drayden, little does she know what's truly in store!

title: Team Eevee and the Pokémon Rescue Squad!
overview: Traveling to Vertress City and the Unova League, our heroes are introduced to a brave family on a mission of service!

title: Curtain Up, Unova League!
overview: The Unova League is off and running, old friends and rivals are reuniting, and the battle action is unrelenting!

title: Mission: Defeat Your Rival!
overview: As the battle excitement in Vertress City builds to a fever pitch, the Unova League pairs friends and rivals, old and new!

title: Lost at the League!
overview: While the Unova League prepares to move to the third round, our heroes are faced with a case of lost and found!

title: Strong Strategy Steals the Show!
overview: As the Unova League makes its way through the third round and barrels toward the quarterfinals, strategy and friendship lead the way!

title: Cameron's Secret Weapon!
overview: It's the fourth round of the Unova League, and Cameron's "secret weapon" turns out to be more than anyone thought, including Cameron!

title: A Unova League Evolution!
overview: As the Unova League roars toward the final match, the competition becomes more fierce, and the strength and skill levels more amazing!
